jobs.title: Senior Revenue Operations Manager
jobs.description:
What is Amplemarket all about?

Amplemarket's premise is that a lot of the playbooks used by B2B sales teams that worked 5 years ago don't cut it anymore.

In today's environment, sales teams need to have a tremendous amount of information about their prospects to decide when is the best moment and channel to reach out in the most relevant way. You can't do this with 5 different data/sales enablement point solutions that don't share the same data schema and barely communicate with each other. Amplemarket is the all-in-one compound solution that enables this.

Our AI-powered sales platform helps B2B companies generate more opportunities thanks to our advanced lead generation engine, hyper-personalized sequencing, omnichannel outreach, and AI-powered smart actions. We are backed by Y Combinator, and we are powering the sales teams at some of the fastest-growing companies in the world like Deel, Moveworks, H1 and Vanta.

At Amplemarket, we help revenue teams prospect smarter, personalize at scale, and close more deals with the power of AI.

As our Senior Revenue Operations Manager, you will be the strategic and operational backbone of our GTM engine designing systems, processes, and insights that drive predictable, scalable revenue growth . You’ll partner with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, and Product to turn data into action, remove friction from the buyer journey, and accelerate our go-to-market execution.

You will:

Strategic Revenue Enablement

- Partner with GTM leadership to design and execute revenue strategies that improve conversion rates, shorten sales cycles, and increase ACV

- Define and manage rules of engagement, territory models, and account assignments to ensure efficiency and fairness across segments (SMB, MM, Enterprise)

- Lead forecasting and pipeline inspection cadences to maintain ±5% accuracy and actionable insights for leadership

Process Design & Optimization

- Map and continuously improve the end-to-end revenue process from lead routing to renewal ensuring simplicity, scalability, and alignment across Marketing, Sales, and CS

- Deploy AI-powered workflows for lead research, scoring, routing, and personalization, measuring performance against baseline metrics

- Drive adoption of process changes through enablement, documentation, and coaching

Systems Ownership & Insights

- Own the GTM tech stack ensuring data integrity, integrations, and automation across systems

- Build dashboards and reporting that surface actionable KPIs for pipeline, bookings, churn, and expansion

- Collaborate with Product and Marketing to connect product usage data with commercial insights

Cross-Functional Leadership

- Lead high impact projects (system migrations, pricing/packaging changes, GTM launches) involving multiple stakeholders across Revenue Leadership, Finance, Legal, and Product

- Influence strategic decisions by presenting data-backed recommendations on pricing, packaging, and contract structures

About You:

- 4+ years in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or a related GTM operations role, ideally in SaaS

- Proven experience partnering with Sales, Marketing, and CS leadership to deliver measurable growth outcomes

- Advanced Salesforce administration and reporting skills; experience managing integrated GTM stacks

- Track record of designing and executing processes that improved revenue predictability and efficiency

- Strong project management and stakeholder alignment skills, with examples of leading initiatives from idea to adoption

- Data-driven mindset with proficiency in analytics tools (e.g., Meta, Looker, or native CRM dashboards)

- Experience in early stage or high growth environments, comfortable wearing both strategic and tactical hats

A little more about Amplemarket:

- We are a post-Series A start-up

- We are backed by YCombinator

- Fast growing startup with product market fit

- Founders also created  https://fermatslibrary.com

- You can listen more about us here:  https://bit.ly/2W7fVDR

We offer:

- Nice work environment

- Competitive Salary

- Health Insurance

- Stock Options

- Annual Company Trip in a secret location

- and more!

Amplemarket is committed to creating an inclusive employee experience for all.

Regardless of race, gender, religion, sexual orientation, age, disability, or if you’re parenting the next generation of innovators, we firmly believe that what truly matters is how your skills, knowledge and personality fit our company. So bring your best professional version of yourself, and apply - we'd like to hear from you!

This is a hands-on role for someone comfortable working across paid, SEO, AEO, product marketing, and content - bringing people together, driving execution, and measuring what works.

This role has a clear path to Head of Marketing.

You will:

Drive Marketing Growth

- Turn quarterly priorities into clear plans, make tradeoffs, and drive execution across the Marketing team.

- Identify and test new growth opportunities across channels.

- Track performance and use data to prioritize what to scale, improve, or stop.

- Own targets for inbound demand: demo requests, inbound pipeline, and conversion from visitor to demo to qualified opportunity.

Own Paid, SEO & AEO

- Own paid acquisition end-to-end, including channel strategy, budget allocation, creative testing, CAC, and payback.

- Develop and execute an SEO strategy across content, technical SEO, and measuring traffic that converts.

- Build our AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) strategy so Amplemarket is cited and recommended in ChatGPT and other AI answer engines.

Lead Product Marketing

- Own positioning, messaging, and go-to-market plans for product launches in partnership with Product and Sales.

Guide Content

- Set briefs and direction for content based on business and growth priorities.

- Partner with the Content team to ensure output is relevant, high-quality, and aligned with our goals.

Drive Cross-Functional Execution

- Coordinate with Sales, Product, Content, Design, Events, and Engineering to keep initiatives moving.

- Build strong working relationships and drive progress through influence rather than formal authority.

- Coordinate with sales enablement to effectively position new products, messaging, and materials in live deals.

About you:

- 5+ years of experience in Marketing, Growth, or Demand Generation, ideally in B2B SaaS.

- Experience marketing to Sales and Revenue leaders.

- Proven experience owning paid acquisition and SEO; AEO experience is a plus.

- Strong product marketing and sales enablement experience.

- Comfortable coordinating cross-functional teams without formal management authority.

- Hands-on, analytical, and comfortable working across multiple areas of marketing, using AI and automation to improve execution.

As Head of Partnerships , you’ll own our partnerships channel end-to-end - from defining the strategy and partner mix to driving revenue, pipeline, and long-term growth. You’ll work closely with Sales, RevOps, Marketing, Product, Legal, Finance, and CS to build a scalable and disciplined partner program.

You’ll lead the Partnerships team, build the processes and systems needed to scale the channel, and develop strong relationships with our most strategic partners.

You will:

- Define, implement, and prioritize our channel strategy: which partner types we invest in and which we deprioritize, the economics and guardrails for each, the target mix, and the run-rate the channel should reach.

- Be accountable for the channel's new business target and forecast, reported on a single governed revenue definition used in every recap, QBR, and target.

- Own the onboarding, mentoring, development, and performance management of the partner base, from first activation through ongoing reviews, with a program that rewards partners for performance.

- Own the quality of partner-sourced pipeline and its handoff into Sales, in close alignment with the AE team.

- Ensure partner compliance with program terms and agreements, applied consistently regardless of partner size, and keep the channel's concentration and legacy arrangements under control.

- Manage channel conflict by upholding clear rules of engagement between partners and the direct sales team, with strong internal and external communication.

- Drive new monetization for the channel by developing new initiatives with Marketing, Sales, Product, Legal, and partners, across the reseller, services, technology, and startup ecosystems.

- Discover new relationship opportunities in the reseller, service, and technology partner ecosystems.

- Build and maintain executive-level relationships with our most important partners, and run a proactive planning process with them that sets shared performance goals and benchmarks.

- Proactively examine, clarify, and validate partner needs, and be the partner community's advocate in internal planning with Marketing, Sales, Product, RevOps, CS, and Legal.

- Lead, coach, and develop the partnerships team; build scalable processes; own the partner tooling and reporting stack with RevOps.

- Contribute to channel management best practices and keep the program benchmarked against the market.

About you:

- 5+ years in partnerships, channel, or alliances at a B2B SaaS company, including 2+ years owning a partner channel's revenue number.

- At least one channel strategy you defined and then implemented yourself, from diagnosis through program design to operating results.

- A track record of scaling a partner program while keeping it disciplined: consistent enforcement of terms, evolving program structures over time, and focusing effort on what converts.

- Fluent working with sales leadership and AEs, RevOps, Product, Legal, Finance, and CS.

- Operational discipline: you document, automate, and build things a small team can run.

- Experience in sales-tech, sales intelligence, or GTM tooling is a strong advantage.

We are looking for an experienced, motivated, and passionate Customer Success Manager to join our Customer Team at Amplemarket.

At Amplemarket, we are on a mission to set the highest standards in customer experience. We believe exceptional customer experience not only drives growth and retention, but also turns customers into enthusiastic champions and advocates of our platform.

As a Customer Success Manager, you will be the trusted advisor to our customers, ensuring they achieve their desired outcomes through the use of Amplemarket. You will be responsible for building strong, long-term relationships, identifying opportunities for expansion, and proactively addressing challenges to ensure customer satisfaction and success.

You will:

- Own and manage a portfolio of customer accounts , fostering strong business relationships with external stakeholders at all levels

- Act as a trusted advisor , guiding customers through their entire journey with Amplemarket, from onboarding to renewal, helping them achieve their business goals

- Lead the onboarding process for new customers, ensuring a seamless transition from sales to customer success, including live product training sessions

- Track and report on key metrics , including customer satisfaction, NPS, retention rates, growth, and more

- Identify expansion opportunities and manage upsell initiatives

- Proactively monitor account health to identify risks early and be proactive at mitigating churn

- Be the voice of the customer within Amplemarket , advocating for product improvements and new features by collaborating with product, engineering, sales, and marketing teams

- Contribute to process improvements by helping to define and refine customer success workflows and best practices

Who we’re looking for:

- 3+ years of experience in customer success, account management, or a similar customer-facing role, preferably in a SaaS environment

- A customer-centric mindset with a passion for delivering exceptional experiences and driving positive outcomes

- Exceptional relationship-building skills , capable of engaging with a range of stakeholders, from end-users to executive sponsors

- A proven track record in managing complex customer relationships , achieving renewals, driving expansions, and building customer advocacy

- Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage and report on multiple accounts efficiently in a fast-paced environment

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills —you will be the primary point of contact for your accounts and must communicate clearly and effectively

- Analytical skills —you’ll forecast potential ARR changes and prepare data-driven QBRs for your customers

- Solid project management experience to ensure smooth customer onboarding and ongoing success

- Commercial acumen with the ability to identify, nurture, and close growth opportunities within your book of business

- Ability to thrive in a remote-first environment and collaborate effectively with multiple internal teams

Nice to have:

- Previous experience in sales

- Previous experience in marketing (Growth/Performance)

- Experience working in a high-growth startup environment

- Familiarity with remote-first work practices
